item.title: Timdoros Lychchratides ~1301 swore to Ersstratos Asheststratides ~1377 by Hera of the yoke
item.description: Timdoros Lychchratides ~1301 swore to Ersstratos Asheststratides ~1377 by Hera of the yoke: a year and a day, and longer.

item.title: Timdoros Lychchratides ~1301 carved Ersstratos Asheststratides ~1377's name into a rib-bon
item.description: Timdoros Lychchratides ~1301 carved Ersstratos Asheststratides ~1377's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.
